title: The Tournament Bar Tab and Delivery
lessons: The player sees a 2026 promotion where White Claw opened a large bar tab around basketball tournament viewing to change habitual drink orders.
The player already knows which White Claw line they want and uses the brand site to find it nearby or order delivery where available.

text: The office pool is going, the tournament's on the bar TV after work, and there's a sign by the taps: first round's partly on White Claw. Ask about it.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You paid part of the first round during the office pool?

entry-first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: In the bars that signed up, yes. This is new for me. Actually paying for attention, instead of just having it.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Wait, you usually get it for free?

entry-first-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: One summer I cut my ads and the internet made me bigger anyway. I got famous by accident. You can't plan an accident twice, so this time I'm just buying the round.

choice-first.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Bartender's looking at you. Usual, or mine?

choices.text: That's honest. Fame you didn't make isn't fame you control.
So the bar tab is you buying back the summer the internet gave you for free.
I don't want an alcohol brand using sports and a bar tab to push one more round.

first-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Thank you. The tab gets me the first one. Whether you order a second is on the drink, not the sign.

first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yeah. It is. That summer was free and it wasn't mine. This one costs money and it is. I know which one I'd rather have. I'm not sure I get to pick.

first-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then keep your usual order.

first-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Even on your tab?

first-3-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: The promotion lowers the barrier. It doesn't confiscate your free will.
You know exactly which line you want. Two stores near the office don't have it. The site has a Find Near Me button and a delivery option.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I know exactly which one I want and nobody near the office seems to have it.

entry-return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: That's when I stop being a personality and become a locator.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Finally, something useful.

entry-return-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Find it nearby, or get it delivered if your area does that. I'm not going to make scarcity romantic just because it made a good meme once.

choice-return.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Two stores in walking distance have it. Delivery's forty minutes. Pick.

choices.text: I like not driving around after work looking for one flavor.
If it's this easy to get, I stop thinking about whether I want it.
If I can't find it easily, I'll just buy something else.

return-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Good. Being where you are is the least fun part of me and probably the most important one.

return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yeah. Making it easy is good for me. It also takes away the moment where you might've walked past. I'd be lying if I said I hadn't thought about that.

return-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then don't drive across town for me. I'm a seltzer, not a scavenger hunt.
